item.description:
Blue-winged Parrotlet

Tiny parrot with green body, short pointed tail, and pale bill. Males have cobalt-blue wings and rump; females are all green. Highly gregarious. Widespread from Bolivia across much of eastern Brazil, as far south as northeastern Argentina.

📸: @my_little_sensor
